Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class SinglePoolSchemaRoutingDataSource

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.SinglePoolSchemaRoutingDataSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Wrapper, CommonDataSource, DataSource
public final class SinglePoolSchemaRoutingDataSource extends Object implements DataSource
Canonical single-pool PostgreSQL search_path operational DataSource.

Unlike AbstractRoutingDataSource (which switches physical databases/pools) or generic DelegatingDataSource subclasses (which allow mutable rebinding, lazy checkout or per-call credential switching), this final adapter binds immutably to one direct operational pool, forbids per-call credential overrides and pool unwrapping, validates PostgreSQL schema identifiers strictly, and enforces search_path isolation across autoCommit and explicit transactions while preserving ConnectionHolder reference identity for BulkExecutionInfrastructure.
